- **Hairline Partition (`#E8E4DC`):** A calibrated, stone-derived border color engineered for subtle, razor-thin structural dividers.

Avoid gradients, drop-shadows, or synthetic ambient glows. Surface hierarchy is communicated strictly through planar color blocking and hairline divisions.

## Brand & Style

This design system reflects high-end Mediterranean artisanal craft, architectural restraint, and editorial beauty. Tailored for an elite hair atelier in Bornova, Izmir, the interface treats appointments, stylists, and hair treatments as bespoke editorial features rather than utilitarian salon services.

The design movement combines **Minimalism** with **Contemporary Editorial Print**:
- **Tone & Sensibility:** Quiet luxury, tactile, patient, disciplined, and bespoke.
- **Visual Tenets:** Generous, rhythmic negative space; razor-sharp 1px hairline rules; asymmetrical editorial pacing paired with rigorous architectural alignment; absolute absence of skeuomorphic gloss, blur, or bubbly corners.
- **Emotion:** Exclusivity, tranquility, and refined confidence. The user feels as though they are browsing an archival art monograph or an exclusive lookbook.

## Layout & Spacing

The layout is built upon an architectural grid with deliberate asymmetry to convey an editorial lookbook feel:

- **Grid Architecture:** 12-column grid on desktop (`> 1024px`), 6-column on tablet (`768px - 1023px`), and 4-column on mobile (`< 767px`). Content modules align strictly to the 1px bounding matrix.
- **Asymmetric Composition:** Large hero features and treatment portfolios balance heavy photographic blocks with generous, off-center typographic panels. Left-aligned serifs juxtapose against right-anchored booking modules.
- **Vertical Rhythm:** Space is deliberately expansive. Sections breathe through multiples of `space-xl` (56px) or compound margins (80px–120px on desktop), cultivating a relaxed, unhurried atmosphere.
- **Edge Restraint:** Outer margins are wide (`4rem` on desktop) to enclose the interface like the matte border of a fine art print.

## Elevation & Depth

Visual hierarchy relies entirely on **Tonal Layers** and **Low-Contrast Outlines**.

- **No Shadows:** Shadows are omitted entirely. There are no blurry drop shadows, inner glows, or floating cards.
- **Plane Separation:** Depth is produced by nesting `#F5F2ED` (Cream Container) against `#FAF9F7` (Ivory Canvas).
- **Hairlines (`1px solid #E8E4DC`):** All containers, data cells, calendar matrices, and image borders use strict, uniform 1px hairlines. 
- **Active & Focus Elevation:** Active states or selected cards transition their outline from `#E8E4DC` to `#1A1A1A` or `#B8860B`, communicating priority through chromatic sharpness rather than physical elevation.

## Components

### Buttons
- **Primary:** Solid `#1A1A1A` charcoal background, `#FAF9F7` ivory label text, 0px border-radius. Padding: `14px 28px`. Font: `label-md` uppercase tracked. Hover state transitions background to `#B8860B` with zero elevation shift.
- **Secondary / Outline:** 1px border in `#1A1A1A`, transparent background, `#1A1A1A` text. Hover fills container with `#F5F2ED`.
- **Text Action:** Unframed, `label-md` with a subtle 1px bottom border in `#B8860B` spaced 4px beneath the text.

### Form Inputs & Selectors
- Flat fields on either `#FAF9F7` or `#F5F2ED` with a persistent bottom border of `1px solid #E8E4DC` (or complete 4-sided 1px box for booking steps).
- Focus state replaces the border with `#1A1A1A`.
- Placeholder text in `#1A1A1A` at 40% opacity. Error states indicated by an understated deep terracotta line (`#9C3D2B`), avoiding loud saturated alerts.

### Cards & Service Folios
- Zero drop-shadow. Framed with `1px solid #E8E4DC` or sitting unbordered upon `#F5F2ED`.
- Generous internal padding (`space-lg`). Images within cards must fit flush against top and side boundaries or sit within an inset mat with equal spacing on all sides.

### Lists & Service Menus
- Editorial ledger layout: service title in `headline-sm` or `body-lg`, dotted or fine hairline leader spanning to the price point, rendered in `label-lg` with warm gold accents for signature offerings.
- Individual list items divided by continuous horizontal `1px solid #E8E4DC` rules.

### Checkboxes & Radios
- Sharp square selectors (16px x 16px) with a `1px solid #1A1A1A` perimeter.
- Radio buttons utilize an internal solid black square (8px x 8px) rather than a circular disc.

### Chips & Badges
- Rectangular blocks with sharp corners. Bordered in `1px solid #E8E4DC` with an ivory background. Active filter state inverts to `#1A1A1A` background and `#FAF9F7` text.

### Bespoke Atelier Components
- **Stylist Portfolio Strip:** Asymmetrical photo-and-specimen module displaying the master artisan's specialty, editorial portfolio, and slot availability separated by hairline columns.
- **Time Slot Selector Matrix:** A rigorous architectural schedule grid where available times are crisp cream tiles and booked slots are struck through with a fine 45-degree diagonal hairline.

## Brand & Style

This design system reflects high-end Mediterranean artisanal craft, architectural restraint, and editorial beauty. Tailored for an elite hair atelier in Bornova, Izmir, the interface treats appointments, stylists, and hair treatments as bespoke editorial features rather than utilitarian salon services.

The design movement combines **Minimalism** with **Contemporary Editorial Print**:
- **Tone & Sensibility:** Quiet luxury, tactile, patient, disciplined, and bespoke.
- **Visual Tenets:** Generous, rhythmic negative space; razor-sharp 1px hairline rules; asymmetrical editorial pacing paired with rigorous architectural alignment; absolute absence of skeuomorphic gloss, blur, or bubbly corners.
- **Emotion:** Exclusivity, tranquility, and refined confidence. The user feels as though they are browsing an archival art monograph or an exclusive lookbook.

## Colors

The palette draws inspiration from raw parchment, limestone architectural accents, hand-forged shears, and warm brass fixtures:

- **Canvas & Backing (`#FAF9F7`):** An airy, warm ivory that prevents optical fatigue and softens contrast against intense sunlight.
- **Surface & Containers (`#F5F2ED`):** A denser cream tone used for structural groupings, content panels, and subtle alternating section bands.
- **Primary Ink & Structure (`#1A1A1A`):** Deep charcoal—softer than absolute black, delivering high contrast with sophisticated editorial warmth. Used for primary typography, solid button fills, and structural frames.
- **Accent & Metallics (`#B8860B`):** Muted antique gold, applied selectively for micro-indicators, selected states, badges, and curated styling notes. Never used for large structural backgrounds or decorative gradients.
- **Hairline Partition (`#E8E4DC`):** A calibrated, stone-derived border color engineered for subtle, razor-thin structural dividers.

Avoid gradients, drop-shadows, or synthetic ambient glows. Surface hierarchy is communicated strictly through planar color blocking and hairline divisions.

## Typography

Typography establishes an editorial cadence reminiscent of independent print journals:

- **Playfair Display (Headings & Display):** High-contrast transitional serifs provide literary drama and salon prestige. Italic variants may be deployed sparingly within headlines for stylist names, signature services, or pull quotes.
- **Public Sans (Body, Labels & System UI):** A neutral, highly legible sans-serif inspired by federal geometric clarity. It counters the dramatic weight of the serif, ensuring service menus, pricing, schedules, and forms remain immediate and effortless to parse.
- **Micro-Copy & Eyebrows:** Render labels (`label-md`, `label-sm`) in uppercase with generous tracking (`0.12em` to `0.16em`) to establish clear hierarchy without relying on heavy weights.

## Layout & Spacing

The layout is built upon an architectural grid with deliberate asymmetry to convey an editorial lookbook feel:

- **Grid Architecture:** 12-column grid on desktop (`> 1024px`), 6-column on tablet (`768px - 1023px`), and 4-column on mobile (`< 767px`). Content modules align strictly to the 1px bounding matrix.
- **Asymmetric Composition:** Large hero features and treatment portfolios balance heavy photographic blocks with generous, off-center typographic panels. Left-aligned serifs juxtapose against right-anchored booking modules.
- **Vertical Rhythm:** Space is deliberately expansive. Sections breathe through multiples of `space-xl` (56px) or compound margins (80px–120px on desktop), cultivating a relaxed, unhurried atmosphere.
- **Edge Restraint:** Outer margins are wide (`4rem` on desktop) to enclose the interface like the matte border of a fine art print.

## Elevation & Depth

Visual hierarchy relies entirely on **Tonal Layers** and **Low-Contrast Outlines**.

- **No Shadows:** Shadows are omitted entirely. There are no blurry drop shadows, inner glows, or floating cards.
- **Plane Separation:** Depth is produced by nesting `#F5F2ED` (Cream Container) against `#FAF9F7` (Ivory Canvas).
- **Hairlines (`1px solid #E8E4DC`):** All containers, data cells, calendar matrices, and image borders use strict, uniform 1px hairlines. 
- **Active & Focus Elevation:** Active states or selected cards transition their outline from `#E8E4DC` to `#1A1A1A` or `#B8860B`, communicating priority through chromatic sharpness rather than physical elevation.

## Shapes

The shape system is strictly sharp (`roundedness: 0` / `0px border-radius`). 

- **Architectural Edge:** All elements—buttons, image containers, input fields, badges, modals, and split-screens—feature crisp, right-angle corners.
- **Geometric Harmony:** Sharp geometries highlight the high-fashion editorial direction, echoing marble styling benches, geometric mirrors, and crisp paper stationery. Rounded, circular pill buttons and pill tags are prohibited.

## Components

### Buttons
- **Primary:** Solid `#1A1A1A` charcoal background, `#FAF9F7` ivory label text, 0px border-radius. Padding: `14px 28px`. Font: `label-md` uppercase tracked. Hover state transitions background to `#B8860B` with zero elevation shift.
- **Secondary / Outline:** 1px border in `#1A1A1A`, transparent background, `#1A1A1A` text. Hover fills container with `#F5F2ED`.
- **Text Action:** Unframed, `label-md` with a subtle 1px bottom border in `#B8860B` spaced 4px beneath the text.

### Form Inputs & Selectors
- Flat fields on either `#FAF9F7` or `#F5F2ED` with a persistent bottom border of `1px solid #E8E4DC` (or complete 4-sided 1px box for booking steps).
- Focus state replaces the border with `#1A1A1A`.
- Placeholder text in `#1A1A1A` at 40% opacity. Error states indicated by an understated deep terracotta line (`#9C3D2B`), avoiding loud saturated alerts.

### Cards & Service Folios
- Zero drop-shadow. Framed with `1px solid #E8E4DC` or sitting unbordered upon `#F5F2ED`.
- Generous internal padding (`space-lg`). Images within cards must fit flush against top and side boundaries or sit within an inset mat with equal spacing on all sides.

### Lists & Service Menus
- Editorial ledger layout: service title in `headline-sm` or `body-lg`, dotted or fine hairline leader spanning to the price point, rendered in `label-lg` with warm gold accents for signature offerings.
- Individual list items divided by continuous horizontal `1px solid #E8E4DC` rules.

### Checkboxes & Radios
- Sharp square selectors (16px x 16px) with a `1px solid #1A1A1A` perimeter.
- Radio buttons utilize an internal solid black square (8px x 8px) rather than a circular disc.

### Chips & Badges
- Rectangular blocks with sharp corners. Bordered in `1px solid #E8E4DC` with an ivory background. Active filter state inverts to `#1A1A1A` background and `#FAF9F7` text.

### Bespoke Atelier Components
- **Stylist Portfolio Strip:** Asymmetrical photo-and-specimen module displaying the master artisan's specialty, editorial portfolio, and slot availability separated by hairline columns.
- **Time Slot Selector Matrix:** A rigorous architectural schedule grid where available times are crisp cream tiles and booked slots are struck through with a fine 45-degree diagonal hairline.
